text: Talk at the MTA Computer Science department seminar: *NLP: Industrial Research*.
Paper accepted to **Communications of the ACM**: [Beyond the Pipeline: A Gender Lens on Priorities and Exit Triggers in the High-Tech Industry](https://doi.org/10.1145/3793870).
Paper accepted to the GEM workshop at ACL 2026: [Near-Miss: Latent Policy Failure Detection in Agentic Workflows](https://aclanthology.org/2026.gem-main.30.pdf).
Panel moderator at ISCOL 2025 (Israeli Seminar on Computational Linguistics), Bar-Ilan University.
Invited talk, *Introduction to Generative AI*, at the AI for Family Medicine conference, Herzliya.
Awarded an **ISF research grant** (with Dr. Noa Nelson) to study gender and power in employment negotiations using computational methods.
Received the **IBM Outstanding Research Accomplishment** award.
Paper at **EMNLP 2025** (Industry Track): [Towards Enforcing Company Policy Adherence in Agentic Workflows](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-industry.41.pdf).
Appointed head of the graduate program at the School of Computer Science, MTA.
General chair of ISCOL 2024 at the University of Haifa.
